blockingFindings: F1 HIGH packages/core/src/adapters/html.ts:229-455 (htmlToLines): CPU DoS via deeply nested tags. The 10 MB size cap does not bound work: stack.some() per text node (ontext), currentIndent() per line start and the onclosetag back-scan are O(depth), so total cost is quadratic in nesting depth. Measured: '<b>a' x80000 (320 KB) = 6.8 s, '<div>a' x80000 (480 KB) = 20.9 s, 10 MB would run for hours. Input is attacker-controlled (anonymous visitor upload). The redos test (test/security/redos.test.ts) only covers flat single-line regex input, not nesting depth. Fix: cap frame-stack depth (e.g. 256, frames beyond the cap are not pushed/counted) and maintain hasClass count and indent sum incrementally instead of rescanning; add a nesting-depth case (500 KB of '<div>a') with a time budget to redos.test.ts.
nonBlockingFindings: F2 MEDIUM packages/core/src/findings/make-finding.ts:44-48: masking is opt-in. buildFinding only masks spans passed in input.sensitive and no P01 detector passes any, so a quote sentence containing an account/routing number would be stored raw in quote, quote_snippet and hashed raw into quote_hash. Fix: default spans to sensitiveSpans(snap.quote) merged with input.sensitive, plus a test that a sentence containing 'ABA 021000021' yields '#0021' in quote, quote_snippet and a hash equal to the hash of the masked text.

F3 LOW packages/core/src/memory/mask.ts:36 ACCOUNT_NUMBER_RE: bounded and ReDoS-safe, but misses digit runs longer than 31 digits and alpha-prefixed numbers (IBAN, 'ACCT12345678') because of the \b anchors; the 6-digit minimum also masks unrelated numbers. Document as known gap or widen.

F4 LOW packages/core/src/session/cookie.ts:117-118: verifyCookie fails open if nowS is NaN (exp <= NaN and iat > NaN are both false). Add Number.isFinite(nowS) guard returning an error. Callers also must pass epoch SECONDS (ms fails closed as expired).

F5 LOW packages/core/src/session/cookie.ts:37-47 b64urlDecode uses atob which discards non-zero trailing bits, so the signature segment is malleable (several strings verify). Harmless for a bearer cookie, but reject non-canonical encodings (re-encode and compare) if cookies are ever used as unique ids. Also signCookie does not enforce that the supplied key corresponds to claims.kid (documented, caller's job); and the size cap at line 86 encodes the whole value before checking, prefer value.length > max first.

F6 LOW packages/core/src/adapters/html.ts:225: string input is fully UTF-8 encoded before the size check; check input.length first (a string longer than the cap in UTF-16 units is always larger than cap/3 bytes) to avoid allocating huge buffers. Worker body caps (otherBodyBytes) should front this in P04a.
